## Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial (Frequency)
```{r echo=FALSE}
pol_data <- read_excel("claim_data_cleaned.xlsx")

# Convert variables to factors
# pol_data$solar_system <- as.factor(pol_data$solar_system)
# pol_data$energy_backup_score <- as.factor(pol_data$energy_backup_score)
# pol_data$safety_compliance <- as.factor(pol_data$safety_compliance)

# Fit negative binomial model to predict claims frequency
nb_model <- glm.nb(claim_count ~ solar_system + production_load + energy_backup_score + supply_chain_index + avg_crew_exp + maintenance_freq + safety_compliance + offset(log(exposure)), 
                   data = pol_data)

# Fit logistic model to predict the probabilty of 'zero' claims
zinb_model <- zeroinfl(claim_count ~ solar_system + production_load + energy_backup_score + supply_chain_index + avg_crew_exp + maintenance_freq + safety_compliance + offset(log(exposure)) | solar_system + production_load + energy_backup_score + supply_chain_index + avg_crew_exp + maintenance_freq + safety_compliance,
                       dist = "negbin",
                       data = pol_data)
```

## Log-Normal Modelling (Severity)
```{r lognormal_modelling, echo=FALSE}
# load in data
sev_data <- read_excel("sev_data_cleaned.xlsx")

# Compute 95th percentile cutoff
cutoff <- quantile(sev_data$claim_amount, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter out top 5%
sev_data_filtered <- sev_data %>%
  filter(claim_amount <= cutoff)

# Fit a log-normal distribution to the severity data
lognormal_model <- lm(log(claim_amount) ~ solar_system + production_load + exposure + energy_backup_score + safety_compliance,
                      data = sev_data_filtered)

# Plot the residuals
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(lognormal_model)

# Check if the lognormal assumptions hold
hist(log(sev_data$claim_amount), breaks = 50)
qqnorm(log(sev_data$claim_amount))
qqline(log(sev_data$claim_amount))
```

## Monte-Carlo Simulation
```{r}
set.seed(123)

n_sim <- 8000
n_policies <- nrow(pol_data)

# --- Predict frequency and severity parameters for each policy ---
p_zero <- predict(zinb_model, newdata = pol_data, type = "zero")
mu_freq <- predict(zinb_model, newdata = pol_data, type = "count")
theta <- zinb_model$theta

sev_mu <- predict(lognormal_model, newdata = pol_data)  # log-scale
sev_sigma <- sigma(lognormal_model)

# --- Initialize storage ---
agg_losses <- numeric(n_sim)
total_claims <- numeric(n_sim)  # total number of claims per simulation
all_claim_sizes <- c()          # optional: store all claim sizes to compute average



# Inflation Rates
inflation_avg <- 0.028111845
short_spot <- 0.047406368
long_spot <- 0.025598672
t <- 10

# --- Monte Carlo Simulation ---
for(sim in 1:n_sim){
  # Simulate number of claims per policy (vectorized)
  n_claims <- rnbinom(n_policies, mu = mu_freq, size = theta)  # NB part
  n_claims[runif(n_policies) < p_zero] <- 0                    # structural zeros
  
  # Aggregate number of claims
  total_claims[sim] <- sum(n_claims)
  
  # Simulate claim sizes
  if(sum(n_claims) > 0){
    claims <- unlist(lapply(1:n_policies, function(i){
      if(n_claims[i] > 0){
        rlnorm(n_claims[i], meanlog = sev_mu[i], sdlog = sev_sigma)
      } else numeric(0)
    }))
    all_claim_sizes <- c(all_claim_sizes, claims)  # accumulate all claims
    agg_losses[sim] <- sum(claims) * (((1+ inflation_avg)^ t)/ ((1 + long_spot)^t))
  }
  print(paste((sim / n_sim) * 100))
}

# --- Metrics ---
mean_loss <- mean(agg_losses)
agg_var <- var(agg_losses)
agg_sd <- sd(agg_losses)
VaR_95 <- quantile(agg_losses, 0.95)
VaR_99 <- quantile(agg_losses, 0.99)
TVaR_95 <- mean(agg_losses[agg_losses > VaR_95])
TVaR_99 <- mean(agg_losses[agg_losses > VaR_99])

avg_n_claims <- mean(total_claims) / n_policies  # average per policy
avg_claim_size <- mean(all_claim_sizes)
avg_agg_claims <- mean(total_claims)

percentiles <- quantile(agg_losses, c(0.10, 0.50, 0.90))

# --- Output ---
cat("Expected Loss (mean):", mean_loss, "\n")
cat("Variance of Aggregate Loss:", agg_var, "\n")
cat("Standard Deviation:", agg_sd, "\n")
cat("95% VaR:", VaR_95, "\n")
cat("99% VaR:", VaR_99, "\n")
cat("95% TVaR:", TVaR_95, "\n")
cat("99% TVaR:", TVaR_99, "\n")
cat("Average number of claims per policy:", avg_n_claims, "\n")
cat("Average number of aggregate claims:", avg_agg_claims, "\n")
cat("Average claim size:", avg_claim_size, "\n")
cat("10th percentile:", percentiles[1], "\n")
cat("50th percentile (median):", percentiles[2], "\n")
cat("90th percentile:", percentiles[3], "\n")


# Optional: visualize
hist(agg_losses, breaks = 100, main = "Simulated Aggregate Loss", xlab = "Loss")
```
